note: Ramond-Elliott neurodevelopmental syndrome manifests primarily as intellectual disability, microcephaly, and seizures without prominent reports of congenital heart defects.

evidence.text: Systematic description of 12 individuals with TRA2B-related neurodevelopmental disorder revealed developmental delay/intellectual disability, microcephaly, brain anomalies, autism, feeding difficulties, and short stature, with no mention of congenital heart defects as a core or prevalent feature.

source.title: Clustered variants in the 5' coding region of TRA2B cause a distinctive neurodevelopmental syndrome
source.quote: All affected individuals presented intellectual disability and/or developmental delay, frequently associated with infantile spasms, microcephaly, brain anomalies, autism spectrum disorder, feeding difficulties, and short stature.
